findings.description: Regexp comment stripper removes executable SQL after quote-contained -- or /* token; SELECT '--'; DELETE FROM ... was incorrectly classified non_destructive, suppressing mandatory extra backup indication.
findings.reproduction: Unmodified exact current module mirror with Node22, quoted marker plus genuine DELETE/DROP returned non_destructive; plain DELETE returned potentially_destructive. No actual malicious migration or production incident established.
findings.disposition: Proposed narrow quote-aware comment scanner with safe nested comments and fail-closed malformed strings; 16 local synthetic scenarios PASS; PR-head/merged CI pending.

findings.description: Release workflow policy tests are source-text regex assertions, not full YAML parse or actual trigger/security execution
findings.disposition: No currently confirmed trigger bypass or duplicate proof, retain tests and rely on separate workflow and exact-source CI.

proposed_current_code_changes.scope: Comment-token lexical scrub without changing SQL marker policy; direct helper lines separately read and locally tested
proposed_current_code_changes.tests: 16 synthetic risk cases PASS locally Node 22; original suite and GitHub CI pending
